subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable `systemPromptReport` policy should OpenClaw use for `sessions.json` entries while preserving once-mode bootstrap warning dedupe?
rationale: The current code and tests intentionally persist the full report for warning dedupe, but production data in the issue shows that full report is now the dominant duplicated payload; automation should not choose which report fields are durable product state without maintainer intent.

options.title: Persist only compact dedupe state
options.body: Store the small `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen`-style state in session entries and omit or summarize bulky tool/schema/report arrays from the session index.

options.title: Move full reports out of line
options.body: Keep full report diagnostics available through a content-addressed or SQLite-backed owner path while leaving `sessions.json` with a compact reference or summary.

options.title: Accept current persistence
options.body: Treat the remaining `systemPromptReport` bloat as acceptable and rely on pruning/limits, which would leave this issue open only for broader session-store performance work.

recommendation.title: Persist only compact dedupe state
recommendation.body: Store the small `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen`-style state in session entries and omit or summarize bulky tool/schema/report arrays from the session index.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the current prompt-blob mitigation and has the strongest recent history around session-store size and session management.
